8682db34.title: Gepard TTS One
8682db34.fullDescription:
Gepard 1.0 — autoregressive streaming TTS (555M params, Qwen3.5 backbone + NeMo NanoCodec).
Served via [gepard-vLLM](https://github.com/nineninesix-ai/gepard-vllm) on Olares One RTX 5090M.
~25× realtime, ~50 ms time-to-first-audio on Blackwell. English, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch.

**API (Cartesia-compatible, not OpenAI /v1/audio/speech):**
- `POST /tts/bytes` — batch synthesis (JSON body with transcript + voice)
- `WebSocket /tts/websocket` — streaming sentence-by-sentence TTS
- `POST /voices/clone` — zero-shot voice clone from WAV clip (multipart)
- `GET /voices`, `GET|DELETE /voices/{id}` — voice management
- `GET /health` — readiness (launcher returns 200 immediately; `ready:true` when model loaded)

In-cluster: `http://vllmgepardone:8000`
Shared entrance: `http://<route-id>.shared.olares.com/tts/bytes`

Example batch:
```bash
curl -X POST http://vllmgepardone:8000/tts/bytes \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"transcript":"Hello from Gepard.","voice":{"mode":"id","id":"<uuid>"},"output_format":{"container":"wav","encoding":"pcm_s16le","sample_rate":22050}}' \
  -o out.wav
```

Clone a voice first via `POST /voices/clone` (3–10 s reference WAV), then use returned uuid.
Omit voice id for built-in default voice.

Pipecat / LiveKit: point Cartesia plugin `base_url` at this server (see gepard-vllm README).

Shared HF cache: `/olares/share/ai/model/speech/huggingface`.
Voice store: local Postgres sidecar (persisted under appData/postgres).

1f618c9c.title: Nemotron Audex 30B One
1f618c9c.fullDescription:
NVIDIA Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B — unified audio-text LLM (nemotron_labs_audex architecture).
Extends Nemotron-Cascade-2-30B-A3B with discrete audio tokens + audio encoder for speech/audio I/O.
RTX 5090M (24 GB GDDR7, sm_120) + 96 GB DDR5 + Core Ultra 9 275HX.

What this chart serves:
- Text-only reasoning (thinking + instruct modes via ChatML template)
- Audio understanding / speech recognition / speech translation (audio input via OpenAI-compatible audio_url when vLLM audio path works)
- OpenAI-compatible chat API on port 8000

vLLM caveats (read before installing):
1. **NVIDIA tested vLLM 0.20.0 only** — this chart pins `vllm/vllm-openai:v0.20.0-cu129`. Newer vLLM (0.22+) may add Audex support but is untested by NVIDIA for this model.
2. **Audio extras required** — base image lacks audio codecs; launcher runs `pip install "vllm[audio]"` on first boot.
3. **TTS / text-to-audio / speech-to-speech** — NOT served by standard `vllm serve`. NVIDIA ships separate scripts (`run_tts_vllm.sh`, `run_audio_gen_vllm_rvq_logit_mask.py`, unified S2S) that require checkpoint conversion and XCodec dependencies. Use NVIDIA's inference_scripts_vllm/ from the HF repo for those tasks.
4. **Audio QA server** — NVIDIA's recommended path is `serve_audioqa_vllm.sh` (custom OpenAI audio_url server), not plain `vllm serve`. This chart uses `vllm serve` with sensible MoE defaults from nemotronlabselastic30bnvfp4one; audio input may need client format matching NVIDIA's audioqa client.
5. **Context length** — model supports 1M tokens but 24 GB VRAM limits practical max_model_len to ~8192 with MoE weights (~20+ GB). Increase LLM_CONTEXT_WINDOW cautiously; OOM likely above 16K.
6. **Text-only without audio vocab** — for pure text, NVIDIA recommends converting to textonly checkpoint OR masking audio token IDs via allowed_token_ids. This chart serves the full Audex checkpoint.
7. **License** — NVIDIA Oneway Noncommercial License (not Apache). Noncommercial use only.

- Image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.20.0-cu129 (pinned)

- CUDA graphs: PIECEWISE mode (cudagraph_mode 1, capture_sizes [1,2,4]) — same trick as Nemotron Elastic NVFP4

18ca8381.fullDescription:
VoxCPM2 tokenizer-free TTS (openbmb/VoxCPM2) — 30 languages, voice cloning.
RTX 5090M (24GB) + 96GB DDR5 + Core Ultra 9 275HX.
~4-6 GB VRAM. Alternative TTS to cosyvoice2yueone; best for zh/en multilingual.

OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech (optional prompt_audio clone).

In-cluster: http://voxcpmone:8000

curl -X POST http://voxcpmone:8000/v1/audio/speech \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Hello from VoxCPM2"}' -o out.wav

VRAM budget with vllmgemma4e4bone (~11 GB): run one TTS at a time or use sensevoiceone on CPU.

Shared HF cache: /olares/share/ai/model/speech/huggingface (shared with all STT/TTS apps).
LLM GGUF cache: /olares/share/ai/model/llms/ (separate category).
